list.name: category
list.label: Category
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT category::text FROM v_measurements WHERE category IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest measurement
panels.description: time comes from the MQTT 5 timestamp property (set by the module or by the broker on receipt), never from the ingester's clock.

panels.title: Metrics (curated / total)
panels.description: Stubs are metrics the ingester created on its own and nobody has curated yet (display_name = native_key).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE display_name <> native_key) AS "curated", count(*) AS "total" FROM metrics;
SELECT count(*) AS "Stubs" FROM metrics WHERE display_name = native_key;

panels.title: Measurements by category ($category)
panels.description: Uses the merged category: finds metrics whose category comes from the metric (heat pump) AND those where it comes from the device (a meter in one circuit).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $__interval) AS "time", display_name || coalesce(' ' || display_subname, '') AS metric, avg(value_num) AS value FROM v_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND value_num IS NOT NULL AND ('$category' = 'All' OR category::text = '$category') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Min/max band: HC1 flow temperature
panels.description: Uses display_subname (the unified role of a value), not the raw native_key, so the same query works for any device.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $__interval) AS "time", avg(value_num) FILTER (WHERE display_subname = 'actual') AS "Actual", min(value_num) FILTER (WHERE display_subname = 'min') AS "Minimum", max(value_num) FILTER (WHERE display_subname = 'max') AS "Maximum" FROM v_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND display_name = 'HC1 flow temperature' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Stubs: new metrics that need curating
panels.description: The ingester creates unknown native_keys as stubs (value_type = 'str'). This lists what is still waiting for a name, unit and category.

targets.rawSql: SELECT metric_id, type::text AS type, native_key, value_type::text AS value_type FROM metrics WHERE display_name = native_key ORDER BY metric_id;

panels.title: Last received (per metric)
panels.description: Diagnosis: which topics are delivering right now? An empty table means nothing arrives (e.g. a device missing from the devices table).

targets.rawSql: SELECT device_name AS device, display_name AS metric, display_subname AS role, category::text AS category, unit, max(time) AS latest, count(*) AS count FROM v_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 ORDER BY latest DESC;
